taxes.statute: Tuloverolaki (1535/1992) 124 § (deductions shared among municipal tax, health-care contribution and church tax, `fi/law/tvl_wb20250703.txt`); Statistics Finland, Taxes and tax-like payments: documentation of statistics (stat.fi/en/statistics/documentation/vermak, fetched 2026-11-22, `fi/law/statfi_vermak_doc.html`)
taxes.reclass: not a tax (OECD guide § 6, as decided for the Nordic church taxes): levied by the parishes, collected by Verohallinto with the municipal tax; the 1.x model charges it only with `churchRateBp` (default 0). The OECD Revenue Statistics table for Finland (DSD_REV_OECD@DF_REVFIN, `tools/in_gap2/oecd/FIN.csv`) has one church line, 1210 Church tax, at 0 in 2021-2024, and its 1100 lines (communal tax, tax on income, final withholding tax on interest) name no church tax: the individuals' church tax is outside the general-government figures
taxes.guide: OECD Revenue Statistics Interpretative Guide (Revenue Statistics 2021 edition, Internet Archive 2022-12-15, `tools/in_gap/oecd_interpretative_guide_wb20221215.pdf`) § 6: church taxes are included only in countries where the church forms part of general government; levies paid to non-government bodies are excluded even where compulsory, unless the government is more than an agent
